items.name: Helium
items.note: A noble gas that reacts with almost nothing; it lifts balloons and cools scanner magnets.

items.name: Neon
items.note: A noble gas that lights signs in bright red-orange.

items.name: Argon
items.note: A noble gas that fills light bulbs and welds metal without reacting.

items.name: Krypton
items.note: A noble gas used in camera flashes and airport lamps.

items.name: Xenon
items.note: A noble gas used in car headlamps and projectors.

items.name: Radon
items.note: A radioactive noble gas that seeps from rocks; houses are tested for it.

items.name: Oganesson
items.note: Made in laboratories; named for Yuri Oganessian. Only a handful of atoms have ever existed.
